question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: “One who is fond of collecting and reading books.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bibliophile"** refers to a person who loves collecting and reading books. (पुस्तक प्रेमी)
 
 
• **Example:** As a bibliophile, she spent most of her weekends exploring new bookstores and libraries.
 
 
 
• An **"Archivist"** is someone who collects, organizes, and maintains historical records and archives. (अभिलेखपाल)
 
 
• **Example:** The archivist carefully preserved the ancient manuscripts for future generations.
 
 
 
• A **"Linguist"** is a person skilled in languages or the scientific study of language. (भाषाविद्)
 
 
• **Example:** As a linguist, he was fluent in six languages and specialized in syntax analysis.
 
 
 
• A **"Philologist"** is someone who studies language in written historical sources. (भाषा वैज्ञानिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The philologist analyzed ancient texts to trace the evolution of the language.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Archivist** (अभिलेखपाल): Someone who collects, organizes, and preserves historical records.
 
 
• **Example:** The archivist stored the ancient artifacts in climate-controlled rooms.
 
 
 
• **Linguist** (भाषाविद्): A person skilled in multiple languages or who studies linguistics.
 
 
• **Example:** Being a linguist, she could analyze the grammar of obscure dialects.
 
 
 
• **Philologist** (भाषा वैज्ञानिक): Someone who studies historical texts and their language.
 
 
• **Example:** The philologist's work helped decode ancient scripts.
 
 

38:Tc20,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
